text:
Asha (People Ops): Quick flag — Leah's SIN on the government check doesn't match the PR card name. She's in Canada and said she recently updated her passport but the immigration portal still shows the old name. Need a path that doesn't delay her Monday start.

Connor (HR): For Canada we can accept either: 1) scanned PR card + scanned SIN confirmation (MyCRA) showing matching name, OR 2) recorded video showing PR card + MyCRA screen + signed affidavit. If immigration portal lag is expected, affidavit + video usually clears provisional access.

Leah (New Hire): Morning! I can do a recorded Teams call tonight. The IRCC portal shows pending name update; I also have a court certificate for the name change but official update not reflected yet.

Asha (People Ops): Ok plan: allow provisional Day-1 access for orientation and Slack. Benefits enrollment can be started but marked "pending verification" — enrollment will be activated retroactively if docs clear within 14 days. Laptop and corporate badge remain on hold until verification completes.

Ravi (IT): Confirmed. I can create email and cloud accounts today, but VPN and badge provisioning blocked. I'll hold the laptop at the vendor and tag the shipment "hold-for-verification". DM me when green to release.

Payroll-Bot: Reminder: Canadian payroll validator requires SIN without spaces. Please enter as 9 digits (e.g., 123456789). If name mismatch persists payroll will hold benefit withholdings.

Connor (HR): Leah, please upload: (a) scanned court certificate PDF, (b) screenshot of IRCC pending update, (c) recording of you showing PR card + speaking this attestation: 

"I, [Full Name], confirm that the PR card and immigration portal screenshot shown in this recording are authentic and belong to me. I consent to Redwood Inference storing this recording for onboarding and I-9 purposes."

Leah (New Hire): I've booked the Teams recording for 6:30pm ET and will upload the files to the secure intake link: https://files.redwood.com/onboard-intake. Also re-submitted SIN in payroll without spaces.

Asha (People Ops): I'll log an exception in Onboard Exceptions sheet under tag `canada-sin-pr-name-lag`. We'll keep start date as planned and mark benefits as pending. If verification doesn't clear within 14 days, we'll reassess benefit effective date.

Connor (HR): BG case created BG-55123. Status: docs-pending.

Ravi (IT): Laptop queued but held. Provisioned email and Slack. Leah, expect an invite to set up MFA in DM.

Leah (New Hire): Recording uploaded and court certificate attached (link placeholder). Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Asha (People Ops): Received. Updating BG-55123 to provisional-verified (pending Legal review of court certificate). Payroll: please keep benefits pending until confirmation from HR.

Payroll-Bot: BG-55123 noted. Benefits enrollment set to "pending-docs".

Connor (HR): Legal will review the uploaded certificate tomorrow. If all good, HR will mark I-9 complete and notify IT to release shipment. I'll post back here once Legal signs off. :white_check_mark:
